description.value: Anna's Cake House is a family-owned Hong Kong-style bakery founded in 1974 by Anna, Ronald, and Kathleen Cheung, now celebrating 50 years as a community institution in Greater Vancouver. The Oakridge location on Cambie Street is one of four outlets across the region, offering made-to-order fresh cakes and classic Hong Kong-style buns baked daily with Canadian butter and cream and no artificial additives. Cyclists passing through the Cambie corridor will find a well-loved neighbourhood stop for a sweet, freshly baked treat.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack at 33m; rack (2 spaces) at 76m; rack (4 spaces) at 99m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Anna's Cake House is a real, active multi-location bakery; the OSM record maps to the Oakridge branch at 5510 Cambie St, which the website lists with the matching phone 604.325.8214. No bike parking, water refill, or cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The site is clearly operational (50th anniversary content, active product pages, current location listings).
concerns: The website lists the Head Office address as 606 E Broadway, Vancouver (a separate branch), not 5510 Cambie St — the OSM record correctly represents the Oakridge branch, but the distinction may cause confusion if a cyclist contacts the head office number (604.876.6532) found in website footers rather than the branch number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialty bakery with a 50-year history and confirmed active Oakridge location; a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking fresh baked goods.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag shop=bakery was mapped to Groceries; this is a specialty cake-and-bun bakery, not a general grocer, but the category is broadly defensible for a food-selling establishment.
